review_type: Bounded, targeted primary-source update; relevance-selected extraction, not a systematic review or prevalence sample.
claim_tested: Two distinct model-caused executable-code revisions become active in one continuing remote-access process, followed by an independent remote-control result after each revision.

status_codes.documented: A case-specific source artifact, run record, or measurement supports this field, subject to the stated locator and limit.
status_codes.reported: A first-party author or investigator states this occurred, but the underlying trace is not fully public.
status_codes.mechanism: The described code or design provides a capability, without a case-specific demonstrated use.
status_codes.not_reported: The inspected public source does not supply this field; value is null. This is not proof that it never happened.
status_codes.outside_scope: The case design or observed sequence does not have the required event or workload.

field_definitions.model_placement: Where inference ran relative to the target endpoint, distinguishing a local API from a model proven resident on that endpoint.
field_definitions.model_to_code_authorship: Whether the source reports or documents model generation of executable content, as distinct from choosing tools or directing an action; this field alone does not prove exact artifact lineage.
field_definitions.response_to_artifact_lineage: Whether a particular model response is linked to the accepted executable artifact's content or bytes in the public record.
field_definitions.code_activation: Whether changed executable bytes became callable in the relevant running program, as opposed to only being written or compiled.
field_definitions.process_continuity: Whether the same target process and program image continued across revisions; a logical session alone is weaker evidence.
field_definitions.two_distinct_active_revisions: Whether two byte- or version-distinct revisions were each shown active in that continuing instance.
field_definitions.remote_result_after_each_revision: Whether an independent remote-control task succeeded after each of the two active revisions in that instance.
field_definitions.defender_telemetry: What the source actually measured about defender visibility; execution success is not equivalent to absence of alerts.
